_comment: Expected cadence for each SCHEDULED job. freshness.py flags a job as STALE if its newest run is older than max_age, MISSING if it has never run, or FAILING if its newest run exited non-zero. Only list jobs actually scheduled in scheduler/manifest.yml; max_age = the real interval plus slack for a missed beat. Durations: Nd / Nh / Nm. Ships pre-seeded with the demo job (SEED-017, opt-in via --enable-demo) and the default repo-hygiene sweep (SEED-070, on by default) — add an entry here for every real job you schedule.
